page.content:
Captain who gets Voyager home.

How Kathryn Janeway connects

  • Faction: Voyager crew — Janeway captains the Voyager crew.
  • Series: Star Trek: Voyager — Voyager is Janeway's long way home.

What is Kathryn Janeway?

Kathryn Janeway is the science-minded captain who holds a stranded crew together in the Delta Quadrant and treats the ship as a Starfleet vessel anyway.

Key threads lead to Voyager crew and Star Trek: Voyager.
